overview: Basic probability: sample space, events, counting-based probability, conditional probability, independence, Bayes rule, total probability, aur inclusion-exclusion. GATE me dice, coins, cards, balls-in-bag, divisibility aur multi-stage experiments aate hain.
whyItMatters: 31 PYQs, 1995-2026; har saal probability ka kam se kam ek sawal.
coreConcept: P(event) = favourable outcomes / total equally likely outcomes. Complex events ko AND (multiply, independent ho to), OR (add, mutually exclusive ho to), aur complement (1 - P) se todo.
hinglishExplanation: Pehle sample space socho: kitne equally likely outcomes hain. 'At least one' wale sawal me complement use karo: 1 - P(none). 'Given that' aaye to conditional probability: P(A|B) = P(A and B)/P(B), yaani sample space chhota ho jaata hai. Multi-step experiment ke liye tree diagram banao aur paths ko multiply/add karo.
formalDefinition: P(A|B) = P(A n B) / P(B); Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B).
importantProperties: P(A u B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B).
Mutually exclusive: P(A n B) = 0 (independent se alag concept).
Without replacement: conditional probabilities badalte hain; with replacement: independent.
Sum of dice type: coefficient/generating function ya enumeration.
Symmetry: kisi bhi do positions par aces hone ki probability same.
Repeated trial until success: geometric series (e.g., 'roll again on tie').

formulas.union: P(A u B) = P(A)+P(B)-P(A n B)

keyPropertiesAndIdentities: Independent events ke complements bhi independent.
commonPitfalls: Ordered vs unordered outcomes mix karna.
Conditional me denominator galat (original space use karna).
Divisibility problems me overlap (inclusion-exclusion) miss karna.
